RegisterDescription.ToolTip: Complete GigE Vision GenICam Camera Description

StringReg.Name: DeviceVendorName
StringReg.ToolTip: Name of the manufacturer of the device

StringReg.Name: DeviceID
StringReg.ToolTip: This feature is deprecated (use DeviceSerialNumber). Device identifier

Integer.Name: DeviceSFNCVersionMajor
Integer.ToolTip: Major version of the SFNC specification that was used to create the device's XML

Integer.Name: DeviceSFNCVersionMinor
Integer.ToolTip: Minor version of the SFNC specification

Integer.Name: DeviceSFNCVersionSubMinor
Integer.ToolTip: Sub minor version of the SFNC specification

Integer.Name: DeviceLinkSelector
Integer.ToolTip: Selects which Link of the device to control

Integer.Name: DeviceLinkSpeed
Integer.ToolTip: Indicates the speed of transmission negotiated on the specified Link (bits per second)

Integer.Name: DeviceLinkHeartbeatTimeout
Integer.ToolTip: Heartbeat timeout in milliseconds

Integer.Name: DeviceLinkCommandTimeout
Integer.ToolTip: GCP command timeout in milliseconds

Enumeration.Name: DeviceTemperatureSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects the location within the device where the temperature will be measured

Float.Name: DeviceTemperature
Float.ToolTip: Device temperature at selected location in degrees Celsius

Integer.Name: DeviceUptime
Integer.ToolTip: Total time the device has been powered up, in seconds

Command.Name: DeviceReset
Command.ToolTip: Resets the device to its power-up state

Command.Name: DeviceRegistersStreamingStart
Command.ToolTip: Prepare the device for registers streaming without checking for consistency

Command.Name: DeviceRegistersStreamingEnd
Command.ToolTip: Announce the end of registers streaming

Integer.Name: SensorWidth
Integer.ToolTip: Effective width of the sensor in pixels

Integer.Name: SensorHeight
Integer.ToolTip: Effective height of the sensor in pixels

Integer.Name: Width
Integer.ToolTip: Width of the ROI in pixels

Integer.Name: Height
Integer.ToolTip: Height of the ROI in pixels

Integer.Name: OffsetX
Integer.ToolTip: Horizontal offset from origin to ROI

Integer.Name: OffsetY
Integer.ToolTip: Vertical offset from origin to ROI

Enumeration.Name: BinningHorizontalMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Mode of the horizontal binning

Integer.Name: BinningHorizontal
Integer.ToolTip: Number of horizontal sensor cells combined (binning). Default: 1. Range: 1 to 2.

Enumeration.Name: BinningVerticalMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Mode of the vertical binning

Integer.Name: BinningVertical
Integer.ToolTip: Number of vertical sensor cells combined (binning). Default: 1. Range: 1 to 2.

Integer.Name: DecimationHorizontal
Integer.ToolTip: Horizontal subsampling of the image

Integer.Name: DecimationVertical
Integer.ToolTip: Vertical subsampling of the image

Enumeration.Name: PixelFormat
Enumeration.ToolTip: Format of the pixels provided by the device

Enumeration.Name: PixelSize
Enumeration.ToolTip: Total size in bits of a pixel of the image

Enumeration.Name: PixelColorFilter
Enumeration.ToolTip: Type of color filter array (CFA)

Integer.Name: PayloadSize
Integer.ToolTip: Provides the number of bytes transferred for each image or chunk on the stream channel

Boolean.Name: ReverseX
Boolean.ToolTip: Flip horizontally the image sent by the device

Boolean.Name: ReverseY
Boolean.ToolTip: Flip vertically the image sent by the device

Enumeration.Name: TestPatternGeneratorSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects which test pattern generator to configure

Enumeration.Name: TestPattern
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects the type of test pattern generated by the device

EnumEntry.Name: Increment
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Pixel value increments by 1 for each pixel

EnumEntry.Name: PulseOnStartOfLine
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Pulse at start of every line

Enumeration.Name: AcquisitionMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the acquisition mode of the device

EnumEntry.Name: MultiFrame
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The number of frames specified by AcquisitionFrameCount is captured

EnumEntry.Name: Continuous
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Frames are captured continuously until stopped

Command.Name: AcquisitionStart
Command.ToolTip: Starts the Acquisition of the device

Command.Name: AcquisitionStop
Command.ToolTip: Stops the Acquisition of the device at the end of the current Frame

Command.Name: AcquisitionAbort
Command.ToolTip: Aborts the Acquisition of the device immediately

Integer.Name: AcquisitionFrameCount
Integer.ToolTip: Number of frames to acquire in MultiFrame acquisition mode

Integer.Name: AcquisitionBurstFrameCount
Integer.ToolTip: Number of frames to acquire for each trigger in burst mode

Boolean.Name: AcquisitionFrameRateEnable
Boolean.ToolTip: Controls if the AcquisitionFrameRate feature is writable

Float.Name: AcquisitionFrameRate
Float.ToolTip: Controls the acquisition rate at which the frames are captured (Hz)

Float.Name: ResultingFrameRate
Float.ToolTip: Resulting frame rate in frames/second taking into account the current settings

Enumeration.Name: ExposureMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the operation mode of the Exposure

EnumEntry.Name: Timed
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Timed exposure; duration set by ExposureTime

EnumEntry.Name: TriggerWidth
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Exposure duration is controlled by the width of the external trigger signal

EnumEntry.Name: TriggerControlled
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Exposure starts on trigger and ends on next trigger

Enumeration.Name: ExposureTimeSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects which exposure time is controlled by ExposureTime

Float.Name: ExposureTime
Float.ToolTip: Sets the Exposure time (in microseconds) when ExposureMode is Timed

Enumeration.Name: ExposureAuto
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the automatic exposure mode

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Exposure is manually controlled using ExposureTime

EnumEntry.Name: Once
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Exposure is automatically adjusted once then reverts to manual

Float.Name: AutoExposureTimeLowerLimit
Float.ToolTip: Minimum exposure time in auto exposure mode (microseconds)

Float.Name: AutoExposureTimeUpperLimit
Float.ToolTip: Maximum exposure time in auto exposure mode (microseconds)

Enumeration.Name: AEMeteringMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Auto-exposure metering pattern (vendor): how the scene is weighted

Float.Name: AutoExposureTargetGreyValue
Float.ToolTip: Target grey value (0-255) the auto-exposure drives the image mean toward

Integer.Name: AutoFunctionAOIOffsetX
Integer.ToolTip: AE metering ROI: left edge in pixels (used in ROI metering mode)

Integer.Name: AutoFunctionAOIOffsetY
Integer.ToolTip: AE metering ROI: top edge in pixels

Integer.Name: AutoFunctionAOIWidth
Integer.ToolTip: AE metering ROI: width in pixels (0 = whole frame)

Integer.Name: AutoFunctionAOIHeight
Integer.ToolTip: AE metering ROI: height in pixels (0 = whole frame)

Enumeration.Name: TriggerSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects the type of trigger to configure

Enumeration.Name: TriggerMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Controls whether or not the selected trigger is active

Enumeration.Name: TriggerSource
Enumeration.ToolTip: Specifies the internal signal or physical input line to use as the trigger source

Enumeration.Name: TriggerActivation
Enumeration.ToolTip: Specifies the activation mode of the trigger

Float.Name: TriggerDelay
Float.ToolTip: Specifies the delay in microseconds to apply after the trigger reception before activating it

Integer.Name: TriggerDivider
Integer.ToolTip: Specifies a division factor for the trigger frequency

Enumeration.Name: TriggerOverlap
Enumeration.ToolTip: Specifies the type trigger overlap permitted with the previous frame

Enumeration.Name: GainSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects which gain is controlled by the Gain feature

Float.Name: Gain
Float.ToolTip: Analog gain in dB (0 dB = unity gain)

Enumeration.Name: GainAuto
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the automatic gain control mode

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Gain is manually controlled using Gain

EnumEntry.Name: Once
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Gain is automatically adjusted once then reverts to manual

Enumeration.Name: BalanceWhiteAuto
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the automatic white-balance (gray-world) mode

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: White balance is not automatically adjusted

EnumEntry.Name: Continuous
EnumEntry.ToolTip: White balance is continuously automatically adjusted

Enumeration.Name: GainAutoBalance
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the mode for automatic gain balancing between the sensor color channels

Float.Name: AutoGainLowerLimit
Float.ToolTip: Lower limit of the Gain in auto gain mode (dB)

Float.Name: AutoGainUpperLimit
Float.ToolTip: Upper limit of the Gain in auto gain mode (dB)

Float.Name: Gamma
Float.ToolTip: Controls the gamma correction of pixel intensity (default 1.0 = linear)

Float.Name: BlackLevel
Float.ToolTip: Black level offset in raw sensor units

Integer.Name: GevInterfaceSelector
Integer.ToolTip: Selects which physical link of the device to configure

Integer.Name: GevLinkSpeed
Integer.ToolTip: Link speed in Mbps

Boolean.Name: GevLinkFullDuplex
Boolean.ToolTip: Indicates if the link is full duplex

Boolean.Name: GevLinkMaster
Boolean.ToolTip: Indicates if the link is in master mode

Integer.Name: GevVersionMajor
Integer.ToolTip: Major version number of the GigE Vision specification

Integer.Name: GevVersionMinor
Integer.ToolTip: Minor version number of the GigE Vision specification

Integer.Name: GevDeviceMode
Integer.ToolTip: Indicates the current device mode

Integer.Name: GevSupportedOptionSelector
Integer.ToolTip: Selects the GEV option to interrogate

Boolean.Name: GevSupportedOption
Boolean.ToolTip: Indicates if the selected GEV option is supported

Integer.Name: GevHeartbeatTimeout
Integer.ToolTip: Heartbeat timeout in milliseconds

Integer.Name: GevTimestampTickFrequency
Integer.ToolTip: Tick-frequency of the timestamp counter in Hz

Integer.Name: GevTimestampValue
Integer.ToolTip: Latched value of the timestamp counter

Integer.Name: GevCCP
Integer.ToolTip: Controls the available access to the camera from applications (0=Open, 2=Control, 4=Exclusive)

Integer.Name: GevStreamChannelSelector
Integer.ToolTip: Selects the stream channel to control

Integer.Name: GevSCPInterfaceIndex
Integer.ToolTip: Index of the network interface to use for the selected stream channel

Integer.Name: GevSCDA
Integer.ToolTip: Destination IP address for the stream channel packets (unicast or multicast)

Integer.Name: GevSCPHostPort
Integer.ToolTip: Host port on which the data stream is sent

Integer.Name: GevSCPD
Integer.ToolTip: Delay between each packet transmitted for the stream channel in timestamp ticks

Integer.Name: GevSCSP
Integer.ToolTip: Source port of the stream channel

Integer.Name: GevSCBWA
Integer.ToolTip: Percentage of the Ethernet bandwidth assigned to this stream channel (x1000)

Integer.Name: GevSCBWR
Integer.ToolTip: Percentage of the stream channel bandwidth reserve (x1000)

Integer.Name: GevSCBWRA
Integer.ToolTip: Multiplier of the bandwidth reserve. 1x to 4x

Boolean.Name: GevSCPSFireTestPacket
Boolean.ToolTip: When written true, fires one test packet on the stream channel. Bit 18 of SCPS register (0xD0C).

Boolean.Name: GevSCPSDoNotFragment
Boolean.ToolTip: Sets the DoNotFragment bit in IP headers of stream packets (bit 17 of SCPS register)

Boolean.Name: GevSCPSBigEndian
Boolean.ToolTip: Indicates the endianness of multi-byte pixel data for this stream. Bit 16 of SCPS register (0xD0C).

Integer.Name: GevSCPSPacketSize
Integer.ToolTip: Packet size in bytes on the stream channel (payload + all headers). Per GigE Vision spec, encoded in lower 16 bits of register 0xD0C.

Integer.Name: GevSCPD_Delay
Integer.ToolTip: Delay (in timestamp ticks) between the end of the previous frame and the first packet of the next frame

Integer.Name: GevSCFTD
Integer.ToolTip: Delay for frame transmission start after exposure complete (in timestamp ticks)

Integer.Name: GevSCSP_GVSP
Integer.ToolTip: Indicates the GVSP stream capabilities (extended header, 64-bit block ID support, etc.)

Enumeration.Name: UserSetSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects the feature User Set to load, save or configure

Command.Name: UserSetLoad
Command.ToolTip: Loads the User Set specified by UserSetSelector to the device and makes it active

Command.Name: UserSetSave
Command.ToolTip: Saves the current device settings to the User Set specified by UserSetSelector

Enumeration.Name: UserSetDefault
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects the User Set to load and make active when the camera is power-cycled or reset

Boolean.Name: ChunkModeActive
Boolean.ToolTip: Activates the inclusion of Chunk data in the payload of the image

Enumeration.Name: ChunkSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects which chunk data to enable or control

Boolean.Name: ChunkEnable
Boolean.ToolTip: Enables the inclusion of the selected Chunk data in the payload of the image

Integer.Name: ChunkFrameID
Integer.ToolTip: Frame ID of the current frame (from chunk data)

Integer.Name: ChunkTimestamp
Integer.ToolTip: Timestamp of the current frame (from chunk data)

Float.Name: ChunkExposureTime
Float.ToolTip: Exposure time used to capture the image (from chunk data)

Float.Name: ChunkGain
Float.ToolTip: Gain used to capture the image (from chunk data)

Integer.Name: ChunkWidth
Integer.ToolTip: Width of the image in the current payload

Integer.Name: ChunkHeight
Integer.ToolTip: Height of the image in the current payload

Integer.Name: ChunkOffsetX
Integer.ToolTip: OffsetX of the image in the current payload

Integer.Name: ChunkOffsetY
Integer.ToolTip: OffsetY of the image in the current payload

Integer.Name: ChunkPixelFormat
Integer.ToolTip: Pixel format of the image in the current payload

Integer.Name: TestPendingAck
Integer.ToolTip: Tests the device's pending acknowledge feature. Device will hold response for this many milliseconds.

Command.Name: DeviceRegistersCheck
Command.ToolTip: Perform a validation of the current device configuration for consistency

Boolean.Name: DeviceRegistersValid
Boolean.ToolTip: True if the current device configuration is consistent

Integer.Name: TLParamsLocked
Integer.ToolTip: Transport layer parameter lock. Set to 1 by the host before acquisition start to lock image format parameters. Set to 0 after acquisition stop.

Port.Name: Device
Port.ToolTip: The port used to access the camera registers via GVCP
